title: 시장에서 장보기: 과일과 채소 이름
objective: By the end, you can name common fruits and vegetables in Korean, tell which group each one belongs to, and use them in short sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday Korean words for fruits and vegetables you will see at a market or supermarket.

task.title: Use fruit and vegetable words
task.line: Read each item and choose, write, or put the Korean words in order, using the word list on page 1.

words.exampleMeaning: I eat fruit in the morning.
I eat a lot of vegetables.
I bought banana milk at the convenience store.
I put tomatoes in the spaghetti.

exercises: Is it 과일 or 채소? Write one word for each: ① 수박 ② 오이 ③ 감자 ④ 바나나
Fill in the blank with a small, red, sweet fruit: 생일 케이크 위에 ____가 있어요.
Choose the right word: ① 스파게티에 (딸기 / 토마토)를 넣어요. ② 디저트로 (사과 / 감자)를 먹어요. ③ (오이 / 바나나)는 초록색 채소예요.
What does 배 mean here? Write 'pear' or 'stomach': ① 배가 아파요. ② 배 두 개 주세요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence. Start with 어제, put 시장에서 second, and end with 샀어요: 배를 / 시장에서 / 샀어요 / 어제
answers: ① 과일 ② 채소 ③ 채소 ④ 과일
① 토마토 ② 사과 ③ 오이
